I am an incoming Junior enrolled in the IB program at my school, could you tell me what I can expect going in?

Absolutely, which options did you take? I study the following:

  • Physics HL
  • Computer Science HL
  • Business and Management HL
  • Math SD
  • English language and literature SD
  • Spanish SD

I have been doing the International Baccalaureate system for most my school years (MYP), I would highly recommend making sure that you get work done as soon as they give it to you as all deadlines co-inside which is the thing that gives most students and me problems. IA's are important to get done early as you then may get an extra draft which can give you a vital few points over what you otherwise could have done. Also no matter what class take really good notes following the syllabus points as that is going to make revision much easier when it comes to mocks (which I have soon [janurary]).

For the other stuff just stay on top of CAS (community, action and service) and pick something you like for your extended essay as you are going to be spending a hell of a lot of time on that.

Most of all though enjoy it though as it is great in my opinion and many uni's really like it (UK). Do you have any more specific questions?
